title: Elegant 5BR Rosemary Beach Home with Private Beach Access
meta_description: Relax in this elegant 5BR, 5.5BA Rosemary Beach, FL home with private beach access, a private pool, a spacious great room, and a carriage house. Sleeps 12.
description_expanded: DescriptionRosemary Beach Luxury Home w/ Private Pool + Carriage House | Bikes IncludedPrivate saltwater pool. Separate carriage house. Ensuite bathrooms in every bedroom. Signature Rosemary Beach charm.Welcome to Harper Cottage & Carriage House, a refined coastal retreat designed for unforgettable family vacations, multi-generational trips, and relaxed luxury in one of 30A’s most sought-after communities.Step through the home’s signature curved entry and into light-filled interiors where exposed wood beams, timeless European-inspired design, and elevated modern comfort create an immediate sense of calm sophistication. Private Saltwater Pool + Secluded CourtyardAt the heart of the home is a completely private courtyard with a saltwater pool—a rare and highly valued feature in Rosemary Beach.Optional pool heat available: $45/day + taxComfortable outdoor seating for lounging and conversationNatural gas grill for easy alfresco dinnersFully private setting for families and small groupsCool off after the beach, enjoy an evening swim, or linger outside long after dinner. Elegant Gathering SpacesThe open-concept main living area is designed for both connection and comfort.Chef’s kitchen with marble countertopsBeautiful limestone backsplashProfessional-grade appliancesLarge kitchen island for casual meals and conversationDining table for shared mealsComfortable living room with ample seatingLarge TV for movie nights or game-day downtimeThe home feels polished but livable—luxury without losing warmth.️ Flexible Sleeping for Families & GroupsEvery bedroom includes an ensuite bathroom, giving each guest added privacy and comfort.Sleeping spaces include:First-floor guest suite, ideal for multi-generational staysLuxurious primary suite with spa-like bathroomPrivate sitting area in the primary suiteBunk room plus daybed, perfect for kids or teensAdditional guest suite with queen bedThis layout works especially well for families, couples traveling together, or groups who want space to spread out. Separate Carriage HouseOne of the home’s biggest advantages is the private 1-bedroom carriage house—a built-in bonus retreat for guests who want extra privacy.The carriage house includes:Full kitchenLiving areaSleeping accommodationsPrivate space separate from the main homeIt’s perfect for anyone who wants a little more independence during the stay. The Rosemary Beach ExperienceWhen you stay at Harper Cottage, you’re not just booking a home—you’re stepping into the full Rosemary Beach lifestyle.Enjoy access to:Multiple private beach access pointsSeveral resort-style community poolsCharming butterfly gardenPlaygroundWalkable shops, dining, coffee, and seasonal eventsPlus, your stay includes 4 complimentary adult bikes, making it easy to explore Rosemary Beach and 30A like a local.⭐ Why Guests Choose Harper Cottage✔ Private saltwater pool in a secluded courtyard✔ Optional pool heat✔ Separate 1-bedroom carriage house✔ Full kitchen and living area in the carriage house✔ Ensuite bathrooms in every bedroom✔ Chef’s kitchen with marble counters and professional appliances✔ First-floor guest suite✔ Bunk room + daybed ✔ Access to private beach entries and community pools✔ 4 complimentary adult bikes✔ Walkable Rosemary Beach location✨ Make It Your 30A EscapeStart the morning with coffee in the courtyard, bike to breakfast, spend the afternoon at the beach or pool, then gather for dinner under the Rosemary Beach sky.Whether you’re planning a family vacation, celebrating a special occasion, or simply craving a relaxing coastal getaway, Harper Cottage & Carriage House offers the space, privacy, comfort, and location to make your stay unforgettable.Book now and experience why guests return to Rosemary Beach year after year.
